title: Evaluate a Load Combination
signature: double Solve(string expression, string[] names, double[] values)
statement: Evaluate a load combination written the way a code table writes it, such as 1.2D + 1.6L + 0.5S. Each term is an optional sign, an optional decimal coefficient, and a load case name; a missing coefficient means 1. Terms are joined by + or -, and spaces may appear anywhere or nowhere. names and values line up, giving the numeric value of each case. Return the total.
constraints: names are letters only, and CAN be more than one letter - Lr and L may both be in the list
every name used in the expression appears in names
hints: Split into terms before you evaluate anything: scan for + and - that separate terms, keeping the sign with the term that follows it.
Within a term, the leading run of digits, dots and the sign is the coefficient and the rest is the name. An empty coefficient means 1, and a lone minus means -1.

Watch the name matching. If the list holds both L and Lr, matching the first name that fits turns 1.6Lr into 1.6 times L with a stray r left over. Match the LONGEST name that the term ends with, and the ambiguity disappears.

cases.name: roof live load has a two-letter name
L and Lr both defined: the longer name must win
